corrections.name: Therapy CBD
corrections.reason: La première illustration présentait un tapis orné, un plaid et un cuir trop détaillés pour le niveau commun. Le décor a été simplifié en conservant la chaise longue, la pose de réflexion, le carnet et le personnage de référence.
corrections.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production game artwork for a coherent collectible Buddies series. Portrait 4:5 composition, one full illustration with NO border, NO frame, NO text, no watermark, no symbols in corners. Same character design as reference: olive and fresh green anthropomorphic hemp flower body, oval black pie-cut eyes with cream whites, expressive brows and smile, thin black rubber-hose arms and legs, four-finger white cartoon gloves, oversized ochre brown vintage shoes. 1930s hand-inked animation aesthetic, clear very dark green outlines, controlled warm colours, small areas of fine halftone, subtly textured cream stock, consistent believable cartoon anatomy. Entire character and identifying prop visible; character occupies about 70 percent image height; keep 5 percent breathing room around extremities. Use reference for character identity, not its border or musical notes. Original title is semantic instruction only, never draw words. No random music notes, extra limbs, extra characters, unrelated wings, unrelated keys, signature, floating symbols or pictogram corners.
Input image: shared series style and character reference only. Do not copy its strawberries, basket or garden unless requested below. Output portrait 4:5, ideally 1024x1280.
Target: Therapy CBD.
Scene: Thoughtful smiling hemp-flower reclines on an old brown chaise longue, holding a small blank notebook and pencil as if reflecting on the day. Full character fits across scene with both shoes visible, chaise drawn in coherent perspective. Quiet vintage study with one small lamp and framed blank shape, pale cream background. Simple common detail and soft light, no floating symbols, text or medical promises.
COMMON finishing tier: a complete and polished simple illustration. One clear character gag, restrained background with only a few location cues, simple clean shadows, light fine halftone. Do not fill the background with tiny detail or dramatic effects. Same high-resolution crisp drawing quality as all tiers.
Finishing correction: keep the chaise longue, reflective pose, pencil and blank notebook, but use a very plain airy cream wall and a plain floor. Absolutely no ornate patterned rug, no ornate cushions, no elaborate leather stitching, no decorative blanket, no intricate tapestry texture. The chaise is simple brown leather with clean shape and minimal shading, one tiny lamp far behind. Background is mostly open pale cream space. This is a COMMON card with intentionally fewer decorative details than silver/gold. Preserve the exact reference character design and crisp line quality.
